description: Kaspa fee market regime classification (quiet, normal, busy, congested) based on live fee buckets in sompi/gram (1 KAS = 1e8 sompi). Rule: congested if priority feerate >= 1000 sompi/gram; busy if >= 300; normal if > 100; quiet if <= 100. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

title: Crypto Kaspa Fee Regime
